title: Bichromatic Geometric Spanners
summary: For an edge-weighted graph $G=(V,E)$ and a stretch parameter $t\geq 1$, a $t$-spanner is a subgraph $H\subseteq G$ such that the shortest path distances in $G$ and $H$ satisfy $δ_H(u,v)\leq t\, δ_G(u,v)$ for all $u,v\in V$. In metric spanners, $V$ is a finite metric space, and $G$ is the complete graph with edge weights corresponding to the distances between the endpoints.
